components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for running demos, suites, and saves. Flat fill — no glow, no gradient, no lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ff6c37; color: #061018; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: none; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #ff8552; transform: none; box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff6c37; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral secondary action for filters, discards, and modal utilities.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #212121; color: #f2f2f2; border: 1px solid #4a4a4a; padding: 8px 14px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #2d2d2d; border-color: #ff6c37; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff6c37; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action carrying a fail-rose tint; semantic color on a control, never decorative.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.12); color: #f43f5e; border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.3); padding: 8px 14px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.2); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f43f5e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Console Input
components.description: Recessed endpoint field. Sits darker than its surroundings and takes the Molten Ember focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input-field { background: #161616; color: #f2f2f2; border: 1px solid #353535; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 13px; font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; outline: none; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input-field:focus { border-color: #ff6c37; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 108, 55, 0.16); }

components.name: Status Badge (Pass)
components.description: Deterministic verified passing assertion status. The only true pill in the system.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 9999px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-badge-pass { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12); color: #10b981; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3); }

components.name: Status Badge (Fail)

components.name: Method Pill (POST)
components.description: HTTP method readout. Square 6px tab — never a round pill. POST borrows the Molten Ember hue.
components.css: .ds-method { font-family: 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-method-post { background: rgba(255, 108, 55, 0.12); color: #ff936d; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 108, 55, 0.28); } .ds-method-delete { background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.15); color: #f43f5e; border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.3); }

narrative.overview:
APIForge is an operational instrument, not a marketing surface. The cockpit is dark, matte, and densely legible: a Cold Slate chassis (#1c1c1c -> #212121 -> #242424) stepped in luminance rather than shadow, with a single Molten Ember (#ff6c37) annunciator that fires only when the operator must act or must read a verification payload. Emerald, rose, and amber remain caution and verdict lamps — they mean something or they are not lit.

Density is a feature. The workbench splits a configuration rail from a results rail and keeps both visible; nothing important hides behind a second navigation layer. Every surface reads at rest — no glow, no gradient, no lift — so that the one element that does change state (a focused input, a selected chip, a pressed primary button) is unambiguous at a glance.

The system deliberately refuses the purple-SaaS default, pastel illustration palettes, and glassmorphic blur. Depth comes from three flat greys and a 1px hairline; contrast comes from a three-step text ramp; identity comes from one hot accent and the near-absence of everything else.
keyCharacteristics: Cold Slate chassis: three flat neutral steps separated by 1px hairlines, zero resting shadow.
Molten Ember (#ff6c37) as the sole brand accent; no gradient partner, no secondary hue.
Verdict colors are functional only — pass, fail, review, and HTTP method identity.
Inter for language, Fira Code for anything the machine asserts.
Compact, tool-like rhythm (14px body, 6px interactive radius, 20px card padding).

rules.name: The Surgical Accent Rule
rules.body: Molten Ember (#ff6c37) marks action and state — primary buttons, focused inputs, selected chips and filters, the active navigation item, and the monospace verification surface. It is never used as a background fill, a card, a decorative wash, or neutral chrome.

rules.name: The Semantic Isolation Rule
rules.body: Emerald, rose, amber, and violet appear only where they encode HTTP method identity or a deterministic test verdict. They are forbidden as decoration, on neutral buttons, and in navigation.

rules.name: The Monospace Verification Rule
rules.body: All HTTP paths, payload bodies, status codes, cURL commands, and assertion parameters render in Fira Code. If the machine asserts it, it is monospace.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow is a statement that something is covering the workbench or receiving focus — never a decorative glow under a button, card, or panel.

dos: Do keep Molten Ember (#ff6c37) for primary actions, focus, selection, and the monospace payload surface — action and state only.
Do build depth from the Cold Slate steps (#1c1c1c -> #212121 -> #242424) and a 1px #353535 hairline.
Do render endpoints, JSON bodies, cURL commands, and assertion rules in Fira Code.
Do carry emerald/rose/amber/violet only as HTTP-method or verdict signals, always as the matched fill + text + hairline triple.
Do keep transitions at 0.15s ease, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep text at or above 4.5:1 against its immediate container; the three-step text ramp exists to be used, not bypassed.
donts: Don't add a gradient partner to Molten Ember — --accent-gradient is none by design; no cyan-to-indigo sweep, no purple SaaS pastels.
Don't put a glow or drop shadow under resting buttons, cards, or panels.
Don't use emerald/rose/amber as decoration, or on navigation and neutral buttons.
Don't render a second brand hue anywhere — blue and indigo have no active role.
Don't slow transitions past 0.15s ease, and don't animate without a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
Don't leave cyan-derived values behind in the light theme: --border-glow, --accent-surface, and --accent-border under [data-theme='light'] must derive from #ff6c37, not #38bdf8 / #0284c7.
Don't give .method-pill a full pill radius; 9999px is for .status-badge only.
